dogecoin.text: @BabyDogeCoin Is Baby DogeCoin not a copy of Doge coin, stop this nonsense.
@BabyDogeCoin DOGE is a trademark of Ultra Pro International, LLC. Filed in May 16 (2014) does Baby DogeCoin shut this down too

@BabyDogeCoin Territorialism over the dogecoin brand has struck many in the cryptocurrency ecosystem as ironic. Cryptocurrencies rest on an ethos of distributed ownership. Bitcoin, the original cryptocurrency, was designed so that it’s owned by nobody.
